name: N-MNIST
description: N-MNIST is a neuromorphic event-based dataset of handwritten digits, created by recording MNIST samples with a Dynamic Vision Sensor (DVS). DVS Gesture is a companion dataset in the same neuromorphic event-data family.
citation: Orchard, G., et al. (2015). Converting Static Image Datasets to Spiking Neuromorphic Datasets Using Saccades. Frontiers in Neuroscience, 9, 437.
